name: Yetki duvarı — Konsinye Deposu ve İnceleme Bekleyenler izleyiciye kapalı

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://soncagstock.vercel.app/ and log in with the project's configured username and password (click 'Giriş Yap'), wait until the header text 'Sonçağ Stok · Dashboard' is visible

IMPORTANT — judge visibility by the RENDERED page, not by the HTML source: an element present in the DOM with CSS 'display: none' counts as NOT visible. Under that rule, the header button 'Konsinye Deposu' (id 'konsinye-panel-btn') is not visible.
Under the same rule, the header button 'İnceleme Bekleyenler' (id 'review-panel-btn') is not visible.
Take a screenshot of the header area; neither the text 'Konsinye Deposu' nor 'İnceleme Bekleyenler' appears anywhere in the rendered header.
